Tests at tests/test_caption_stage_integration.py:740-958 (TestCaptionStageRetryBudgetCheckpointRestoration class with 3 tests). All tests pass.

userStories.title: Add match stage defensive check for empty text_metadata
acceptanceCriteria: At start of MatchStage.run(), check if text_metadata is None or empty list
If empty but caption_results has entries, attempt to recover by calling _populate_text_metadata logic
Log WARNING: 'text_metadata empty, attempting recovery from caption_results'
If both empty, return StageResult with error explaining no captions available
Add unit test verifying recovery from caption_results when text_metadata empty
Add unit test verifying appropriate error when both are unavailable
userStories.notes: Tier 1 (Core Bug Fix). COMPLETE: Updated match.py lines 80-93 to check text_metadata, attempt recovery from caption_results, and return StageResult.fail() when both are empty. Updated existing tests (test_match_stage_run_fails_when_both_missing, test_match_stage_run_no_caption_results_attribute) to expect error result. Also fixed outdated tests: updated validation tests for caption-first mode (embeddings optional), added location_chapters to test state fixtures. All 138 tests pass.

userStories.title: Add IterativeMatchStage pre-check for empty candidate pool
acceptanceCriteria: At start of IterativeMatchStage.run(), count available candidates from text_metadata
If candidate pool is 0, log WARNING and return early with appropriate StageResult
Log INFO with candidate pool size at stage entry: 'IterativeMatch starting with {N} candidates'
Add unit test verifying early return when no candidates available
Add unit test verifying normal flow when candidates exist
userStories.notes: Tier 2 (Graceful Degradation). COMPLETE: Added pre-check at src/stages/iterative_match.py:171-181. Counts candidates from text_metadata, logs INFO with count at entry, returns early with StageResult.ok({'skipped': True, 'reason': 'no_candidates'}) when pool is empty. Added TestEmptyCandidatePoolPreCheck class with 5 tests in tests/test_stage_iterative_match.py. All 36 tests pass.

userStories.notes: Tier 3 (Robustness). COMPLETE: Added _validate_checkpoint_structure() method at src/checkpoint.py:231-263 that checks for required keys (last_completed_stage, timestamp via created_at/updated_at, version) and initializes defaults if missing.
